label: Bible Study
prompt: Jesus said unto her, I am the _____, and the life: he that believeth in me, though he were dead, yet shall he live:
verse: Jesus said unto her, I am the resurrection, and the life: he that believeth in me, though he were dead, yet shall he live:
note: Spoken to Martha at Lazarus' tomb — four days in, and about to be very much alive.

label: Warm-Up Word
prompt: Cast thy _____ upon the LORD, and he shall sustain thee: he shall never suffer the righteous to be moved.
verse: Cast thy burden upon the LORD, and he shall sustain thee: he shall never suffer the righteous to be moved.
note: Cast it, don't carry it. Peter echoes this centuries later: 'casting all your care upon him.'

label: Sunday School
prompt: Then flew one of the seraphims unto me, having a live _____ in his hand, which he had taken with the tongs from off the altar:
verse: Then flew one of the seraphims unto me, having a live coal in his hand, which he had taken with the tongs from off the altar:
note: A seraph touched Isaiah's lips with a live coal from the altar — just before he answered, 'Here am I; send me.'

label: Deep Water
prompt: I call heaven and earth to record this day against you, that I have set before you life and death, blessing and cursing: therefore _____ life, that both thou and thy seed may live:
verse: I call heaven and earth to record this day against you, that I have set before you life and death, blessing and cursing: therefore choose life, that both thou and thy seed may live:
note: Moses' closing appeal on the plains of Moab: two roads, heaven and earth as witnesses, and a strong hint which to take.

label: Don't Play With Me
prompt: And he humbled thee, and suffered thee to hunger, and fed thee with manna, which thou knewest not, neither did thy fathers know; that he might make thee know that man doth not live by bread only, but by every word that _____ out of the mouth of the LORD doth man live.
verse: And he humbled thee, and suffered thee to hunger, and fed thee with manna, which thou knewest not, neither did thy fathers know; that he might make thee know that man doth not live by bread only, but by every word that proceedeth out of the mouth of the LORD doth man live.
note: Jesus answered Satan's first temptation with this verse: not bread only, but every word that 'proceedeth.'
